title: Step 68-E Attribute Brand Category structure administration and conflict handling
description: Implement the HIGH-risk Admin Catalog structure workspace on top of canonical Step 68-D. Cover source-proven Brand and Category list/create/edit/sales controls, Attribute definition/value administration, and full-set Product/Variant attribute assignment. Entry audit found a bounded carry-forward contract defect: PATCH /admin/brands/{id} and PATCH /admin/categories/{id} require If-Match in the runtime controller but canonical OpenAPI/generated types omit it. Repair only those exact parameter declarations before frontend mutation work, synchronize generated types and source-proven Step56/57 provenance hashes, then preserve server-owned authorization, exact concurrency, no invented If-Match for assignment PUT, fail-closed mutation ambiguity and Persian RTL accessibility.

dependencies.evidence: PR #364 terminally closed after exact-artifact Project Owner approval; exact-SHA Canonical CI #1945, Phase A #1444, CodeQL #1097 and Storefront Quality #923 succeeded; terminal Lock release comment 6230507852.

evidence.provenance_repair_policy: Only the missing canonical If-Match parameter declarations for PATCH /admin/brands/{id} and PATCH /admin/categories/{id}, generated type synchronization, and exact SHA/manifest provenance refreshes are authorized. No other operation, screen, journey, permission, runtime-release or business semantic may change.

acceptance_criteria.description: Before Brand/Category edit UI is enabled, canonical OpenAPI for PATCH /admin/brands/{id} and PATCH /admin/categories/{id} must declare the same If-Match precondition required by runtime controllers, generated types must be synchronized, and no other endpoint semantic may change.

Brand, Category and Attribute structure reads/mutations use only canonical generated Admin operations through the existing server-owned auth bridge; no browser credential authority or parallel API client is introduced.
Brand create/edit/sales uses only source-proven fields and operations. Brand PATCH uses the loaded canonical version through If-Match; 409 fails closed. No brand delete/archive control is invented.

Category create/edit/sales presents explicit parent hierarchy context, uses loaded canonical version for PATCH, and leaves parent existence/cycle enforcement server-authoritative. No category delete/archive control is invented.

Attribute definitions support only text/number/boolean/select and source-proven fields. Attribute and Attribute Value PATCH operations carry the loaded version via If-Match, while typed values require exactly one text/numeric/boolean payload.

Product and Variant attribute assignment is an explicit full-set replacement using the canonical assignment PUT endpoints; no If-Match guard is invented, each attribute appears at most once, and canonical state is re-read after mutation.

Unsafe Catalog structure mutations are never automatically retried. Network/timeout/5xx or post-mutation reread ambiguity is surfaced as unknown outcome and requires canonical reread before any repeat.

All Admin form mutations enforce trusted same-origin submission and bounded parsing; 401/403/404/409/422 states fail closed with neutral Persian messaging and request-id recovery evidence where available.

AD-C-03, AD-C-05 and AD-C-06 are implemented as Persian RTL, responsive and keyboard-accessible workspaces; product/variant assignment is reachable from canonical product context and preserves focus/revalidation after outcomes.

No Media mutation, Sales-Control apply, pricing/inventory/Excel work, Backend/OpenAPI/generated contract/database change, Storefront change, Product Design mutation or Current-State/Master-Roadmap closure reconciliation is introduced.

Canonical closure requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A and CodeQL, deterministic Review, Independent Security PASS, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock and explicit Project Owner Human Gate approval, followed by protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release.
